Definition: perhaps for G2501; Joses, the name of two Israelites:--Joses. Compare G2499.
BiblicalUsage: Joses is the brother of James, one of the sons of Mary who watched the cross. In Mark 6:3 the people of Nazareth ask, is not this the carpenter, the son of Mary, the brother of James, and Joses, and of Juda, and Simon, in Mark 15:40 Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses looks on from afar, and in Mark 15:47 Mary the mother of Joses watches where the body is laid.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Joses is the quiet brother: named at the cross, named at the tomb, and never given a speech of his own.
RelatedPeople: Joses, Brother of Jesus; James, Brother of Jesus; Jesus
RelatedEvents: The Crucifixion; Jesus Rejected at Nazareth; The Burial of Jesus
